Title: Strategic Sourcing Analyst
Description: Rockwell Automation is a global technology leader focused on helping the world’s manufacturers be more productive, sustainable, and agile. With more than 28,000 employees who make the world better every day, we know we have something special. Behind our customers - amazing companies that help feed the world, provide life-saving medicine on a global scale, and focus on clean water and green mobility - our people are energized problem solvers that take pride in how the work we do changes the world for the better. We welcome all makers, forward thinkers, and problem solvers who are looking for a place to do their best work. And if that’s you we would love to have you join us! Job Description Strategic Sourcing Analyst Summary Rockwell Automation is the largest company in the world dedicated to industrial automation and information. Here, we connect the imaginations of people with the potential of technology to make the world more intelligent, more connected and more productive. From improving the production of medicines that boost human health to reducing waste in an oil and gas plant, the work we do changes how we live. You will lead the data management and quantitative analyses of sourcing activities within the Strategic Sourcing Organization (SSO). The Analyst will include themselves in the strategic sourcing process as they will require working on complex problems that create analytical tools, data recommendations/solutions to problems. Highly desirable skillset/experience using Power BI and Microsoft Power Platform to create these new tools. These solutions will include development, documentation, and delivery of repeatable processes to meet partner requirements. The Analyst will need to meet reporting/project timelines. You will report to the Applied Technology and Analytics Manager. Your Responsibilities Create insightful data for partners. The analyst leads the process design for the collection and analyses of several data sets for the assigned commodities / services. Design, conducts, and synthesizes insightful industry research for assigned commodities to help develop sourcing strategy. Support all financial and performance reporting for SSO. Develop an expertise in the strategic sourcing process The analyst participates in the sourcing strategy formulation, supplier selection and supplier management process led by the Commodity Owner. Teams with Commodity Project Managers / Subject Matter Experts (engineering, marketing, quality) to create commodity / services sourcing strategies. Coordinate requests for quotation (RFQ), create and administer negotiation tools for sourcing activities, prepares fact base for supplier negotiations and business reviews. Analyze historical and future spend/savings by commodity/departments/locations. Report on supplier performance metrics and conducts benchmarking studies. Support other Commodity related activities to ensure success of all partners. Lead data tool/process development The analyst is responsible for the end-to-end design and implementation of new or improved tools for SSO. Gather and analyze requirements, designs solution, implement solution, verify functionality and output, document the tool/process, and define refresh schedule or maintenance. You accomplish this using multiple programs. These programs include MS Excel with Power Query and Power Pivot. They also include MS Power BI, MS Power Apps, and MS Power Automate. Additionally, they feature MS SharePoint, MS Access, and MS SQL Server/Azure. Furthermore, they include SAP and other tools. Understanding of supply chain and Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) reduction opportunities. The analyst is familiar with the different supply chain models. The analyst participates in internal and joint supplier/unit teams. These teams pursue TCO reduction opportunities according to the Sourcing strategy. Examples of these opportunities include lowering inventory levels, increasing yields, improving supplier operations, and demand management. Critical thinking, problem-solving, and root causal analysis skills required. Can manipulate data, summarize findings, and investigate cause. Attention to detail and verification of data/solutions. Can verify the accuracy, logic, and plausibility of data/solutions. Capability to design and apply new standard tools. Work on complex problems requiring the creation of analytical tools, data analysis and providing recommendations/solutions to the problem. This may require learning/developing new tools and deploying them to our organization. Ability to prioritize, manage, and deliver multiple projects/tasks with high degree of accuracy and detail. Strong oral and written communication skills to communicate with management, suppliers, and partners. The Essentials - You Will Have Bachelor's Degree in Supply Chain, Business, Finance, Engineering, or other relevant area. 2 or more years of experience in strategic sourcing, supply chain, analytics, or relevant field. Knowledge of and experience using Microsoft Excel. General knowledge of other Microsoft Office tools (Outlook, Teams, Word, PowerPoint, SharePoint, and OneNote) The Preferred - You Might Also Have Analytical experience combining multiple large datasets into a comprehensive solution. This would contain expertise in MS Power Query and MS Power BI. It should also include expertise in MS Access and any SQL language, such as MS SQL Server or Oracle. Additionally, it would be beneficial to have experience with other mass data combination tools outside of Excel. Experience with Microsoft Power Platform emphasis on Power BI (Power Apps, Power Automate, and Power BI) Experience creating or updating tools and the change management associated with implementing the new process/tool in a large organization. ERP/MRP systems knowledge (SAP preferred). Knowledge of sourcing and supply chain management. Benefits What We Offer: Saving Fund Food coupons. Major medical insurance Retirement benefit We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. At Rockwell Automation we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace, so if you're excited about this role but your experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right person for this or other roles. job type #Hybrid Rockwell Automation’s hybrid policy aligns that employees are expected to work at a Rockwell location at least Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays unless they have a business obligation out of the office.

Title: Analista de Inventario y Ventas
Industries: Mining, Industrial Machinery Manufacturing, and Automation Machinery Manufacturing
Description: Ubicación: Monterrey, México Modalidad de trabajo: Presencial Lo que hacemos en Weir Somos líderes globales en tecnología para la minería de un futuro sostenible. Ayudamos a nuestros clientes a extraer los recursos que el mundo necesita de manera más eficiente y sostenible. El futuro de nuestro planeta depende de la transición hacia energías renovables, y esa transición solo es posible gracias a los metales y minerales que nuestros clientes producen. Por ello, trabajamos codo a codo con operaciones mineras alrededor del mundo para mover menos roca, utilizar menos energía, hacer un uso más eficiente del agua y generar menos residuos. Juntos impulsamos una minería más inteligente, eficiente y sostenible. Genera tu impacto Desempeñarás un papel clave en la resolución de desafíos reales. Aplicarás tus habilidades para lograr resultados que generen impacto, ya sea a través de la ingeniería, la planificación o el soporte a clientes. Trabajarás con un propósito claro, aprenderás cada día y contribuirás a construir un futuro más sostenible. Lo que harás Análisis y Optimización de Inventarios: Analizar y monitorear los niveles de inventario, niveles de servicio y capital de trabajo para asegurar la disponibilidad de productos. Las actividades diarias incluyen la revisión de información histórica de ventas, demanda y consumo de materiales para optimizar inventarios y respaldar las necesidades operativas. El éxito se medirá por mantener niveles óptimos de inventario que equilibren disponibilidad y eficiencia en costos. Los requerimientos de viaje son mínimos, desarrollándose principalmente en las instalaciones de Monterrey. Pronóstico de Demanda y Análisis de Ventas: Desarrollar y monitorear pronósticos de demanda y ventas, identificando tendencias, variaciones y oportunidades de mejora. El cargo implica una evaluación constante de la precisión de los pronósticos y ajustes proactivos para apoyar a los equipos de Ventas y Planificación. El éxito se medirá mediante una mayor confiabilidad de los pronósticos y alineación con los objetivos del negocio. Visualización de Datos y Reportes: Crear y automatizar dashboards e informes utilizando Power BI, Power Automate y Power Apps para transformar datos complejos en información útil para las áreas de Ventas, Planificación y Operaciones. Las tareas diarias incluyen consolidar información proveniente de SAP y otras fuentes, automatizar procesos de reporte y entregar información oportuna para la toma de decisiones. El éxito se reflejará en una mayor accesibilidad de los datos y mejor soporte para la toma de decisiones. Participación en el Proceso SIOP: Participar activamente en los procesos de Sales, Inventory & Operations Planning (SIOP), evaluando el impacto de los cambios en la demanda, capacidad y abastecimiento. Esto incluye la colaboración transversal con distintas áreas para alinear los planes de inventario y ventas con las capacidades operativas. El éxito se medirá por la integración efectiva de los análisis de inventario dentro de los ciclos SIOP. Mejora Continua y Gestión de Riesgos: Identificar tendencias, riesgos y oportunidades mediante el análisis de datos, contribuyendo a la mejora continua de los procesos. El rol requiere iniciativa para proponer mejoras en la gestión de datos y estrategias de inventario. El éxito se reflejará en una mayor eficiencia de los procesos y mitigación de riesgos. La Seguridad es Primero: Demostrar un compromiso del 100% con nuestros comportamientos de cero daño, apoyando nuestro objetivo de desarrollar una cultura de seguridad de clase mundial. Lo que aportarás Requisitos indispensables: Experiencia avanzada en gestión de inventarios, planificación de demanda, pronósticos y análisis de ventas (3 a 5 años). Dominio de SAP (MM, SD, MRP), Power BI, Power Automate, Power Apps y Excel avanzado. Sólidas habilidades analíticas para interpretar información, resolver problemas y generar recomendaciones accionables. Inglés avanzado para una comunicación efectiva con equipos multidisciplinarios. Requisitos deseables: Experiencia con SQL, Python, Microsoft Fabric, Power Query o Power Pivot. Conocimientos en analítica predictiva y automatización de reportes. Experiencia en entornos industriales, manufactureros o de Supply Chain, especialmente en procesos Make to Stock y Make to Order. Experiencia trabajando con grandes volúmenes de datos y múltiples fuentes de información. ¿Por qué unirte a Weir? Vivimos nuestros valores: pensamos primero en la seguridad, hacemos lo correcto, nos respetamos mutuamente, aspiramos a grandes objetivos y buscamos superar las expectativas de nuestros clientes. Incentivamos a nuestra gente a liderar con el ejemplo y celebramos nuestros logros. Nos apasiona nuestro propósito de contribuir a la entrega de los recursos naturales esenciales para construir un mejor futuro para el mundo. Lo hacemos combinando un profundo conocimiento de nuestros clientes, ingeniería de clase mundial, experiencia en ciencia de materiales y automatización inteligente para ofrecer soluciones innovadoras de principio a fin, incorporando nuestras tecnologías distintivas. Creemos que tu voz importa y que tus ideas generan impacto. Trabajamos activamente para fomentar una cultura diversa donde todas las personas sientan que pertenecen y puedan desarrollar el mejor trabajo de sus vidas. Tú también puedes contribuir a fortalecer nuestra cultura única a través de nuestras redes de inclusión e iniciativas de seguridad. Beneficios Remuneración competitiva. Desarrollo profesional y apoyo para el aprendizaje. Acceso a redes globales de inclusión. Beneficios regionales y específicos por equipo. Programa Sharebuilder. Programas de bienestar para ti y tu familia. Colaboración con equipos globales. Apoyo para estudios.

Validated project management skills and capability in carrying projects through to completion. A trust in and dedication to Etsy’s vision, mission and values. Junior FX Structurer Ebury Mexico City - Office based - 5 days of the week As a Foreign Exchange (FX) Structurer you will be responsible for ensuring clients across the EEA receive the most suited FX solution. Responsibilities Comprehensive FX Exposure Analysis: Conduct thorough analyses of clients' FX exposures and existing hedging strategies, accurately assessing their risk profiles. Tailored FX Risk Management Solutions: Design and implement bespoke FX risk management solutions, incorporating a deep understanding of clients' business operations, industry-specific challenges, and the nuances of market dynamics. Advanced Derivative Pricing and Structuring: Utilise sophisticated pricing models to accurately value a wide range of FX derivatives, from vanilla options to complex exotic structures. Develop compelling proposals for customised FX structured products, considering the unique needs and risk tolerances of clients. Strategic Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with front office teams, FX dealing, and FX sales professionals, providing expert insights and support to ensure the seamless delivery of exceptional FX products and services. Proactive Market Strategy Development: Generate innovative and market-driven trade ideas, recommending strategic pricing and structuring approaches for complex FX derivative products, with a keen focus on opportunities and risks within the financial landscape. Technical Proficiency: Possess advanced Excel skills for data analysis and reporting, with Python programming proficiency considered a valuable asset for developing and implementing quantitative models. Title: Manager, Customer Data Services
Description: About Watershed Watershed is the enterprise sustainability platform. Companies like Airbnb, Carlyle Group, FedEx, Visa, and Dr. Martens use Watershed to manage climate and ESG data, produce audit-ready metrics for voluntary and regulatory reporting including CSRD, and drive real decarbonization. We are looking for team members who love product-building, want to work hard at a mission-oriented startup, and will collaborate with us in shaping the culture of a growing team. We have offices in San Francisco, New York, Denver, London, Paris, Berlin, Sydney, Mexico City, and remote team members across the US and Europe. We hope that you'll be interested in joining us! The role Watershed is on a mission to drive meaningful climate action, and our Customer Data Services ("CDS") team plays a key role in making that possible. This team acts as data experts to some of the world’s largest and most influential companies, including Walmart, the Carlyle Group, and Stripe. The team helps customers understand Watershed’s data requirements, advises them on data best practices, transforms their data into Watershed’s templates, and documents the steps for traceability. This work gets customers’ data into the platform quickly and accurately, allowing them to spend more time on their sustainability goals. As a Manager on the Customer Data Services team , you will lead a team of seven Data Specialists in the Mexico City branch of a globally distributed team. In this role, you will enable your team to deliver rigorous, high-quality data services to Watershed’s customers. In addition, you will own strategic initiatives that improve the quality and efficiency of how we deliver, including the integration of AI into the team’s workflows. This is a unique opportunity to be an early leader within Watershed’s Mexico City office. As a key leader in this office, you will play a critical role in building an inclusive, supportive, and high-performance culture, not only for your team, but for the broader Mexico City office as a whole. In this role, you will… Lead and develop a high-performing team. You will coach, grow, and hold a high bar for a team of seven Data Specialists, most of them early in their careers. Own what your team produces. You will own the team’s quality and responsiveness metrics, spot-check work, and build the review habits that keep our output error-free. Coach your team on communication and customer-facing skills. You will review the customer communications, documentation, and presentations your team creates, coaching them on structure, tone, and delivery. When coverage is needed, you will step onto a customer call yourself. Drive day-to-day team operations. You will help the team prioritize work, manage capacity and coverage across a growing book of customers, and remove blockers. Support your team when they’re stuck. You will help Data Specialists think through data problems such as how to make a solution scale, where potential quality risks sit, and when to use certain tools. You will direct them to the right resources when the answer lives elsewhere. Own strategic initiatives that raise the bar. Each quarter you will take on workstreams that improve the quality, efficiency, and value of the team’s work. Lead your team through the AI transition. You will drive adoption and change management as AI reshapes how work gets done. Foster cross-functional collaboration. You will represent your team with Sustainability Advisory, Customer Success, and Project Management leadership on shared initiatives. Be an early leader in our Mexico City office. You will embody and champion Watershed’s operating principles, setting the tone for an inclusive, mission-driven, and high-performance team. You are a great fit for this role if… You bring 8+ years of professional experience, including 2+ years of demonstrated success managing a services, operations, or customer-facing team, typically in a consulting environment or within B2B SaaS. You are a skilled manager who is motivated by coaching, hiring, and developing people who are early in their careers. You are customer-obsessed. You know how to set a high bar for quality delivery and help your team reach it. You are a strong operator who loves to get into the details, uses data to make decisions, and builds repeatable systems in high-growth environments. You are an excellent communicator and can coach others to be one. You can explain a complex situation simply to a senior audience, and you know how to raise the standard for how a team writes and presents to customers. You are comfortable stepping onto a customer call to cover for someone on your team. You are proficient in Excel. You can spot-check the accuracy of work, reconcile totals, and size the risk in a data decision. SQL and Python skills are a bonus. You have experience leveraging AI to drive efficiency and amplify impact. You are comfortable leading a team through that kind of change. You thrive in a high-growth, fast-paced environment. You bring an ownership mentality, curiosity, and a bias to action in everything that you do. You are fluent in written and verbal English. Must be willing to work from an office 4 days per week (except for remote roles) Watershed has hub offices in San Francisco, New York, London, and Mexico City and satellite offices in Denver, Sydney, Paris, and Berlin. Where we have offices, employees are expected to be in office for 4 days per week. Certain jobs are open to being remote and will be specifically noted on the jobs page and in the job description if so. What’s the interview process like? It starts the same for every candidate: getting to know the team members through 1 to 2 conversations about Watershed, your experience, and your interests. Next steps can vary by role, but usual next steps are a skill or experience interview (e.g. a coding interview for an engineer, a portfolio review for a designer, deeper experience call for other roles) which leads to a virtual or in person interview panel. We prioritize transparency and lack of surprise throughout the process. What if I need accommodations for my interview? At Watershed, we are dedicated to ensuring an inclusive recruitment process. We provide reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities, long-term conditions, mental health needs, religious observances, neurodivergence, or pregnancy-related support requirements. If you need assistance during your process, please contact your recruiter.
